question: Identify the structural formula for magnesium hydroxide.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mg(OH)₂**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Magnesium hydroxide has the chemical formula **Mg(OH)2**.
 
• It consists of one magnesium (Mg) atom and two hydroxide (OH) groups.
 
• It is commonly found in nature as the mineral brucite.
 
• Magnesium hydroxide is used as an antacid and a laxative in medicine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnesium (Mg)**

 
 
• Magnesium is a chemical element with the symbol Mg and atomic number 12.
 
• It is a shiny gray solid, and it is the eighth most abundant element in the Earth's crust.
 
• Magnesium is essential for all living cells, playing a key role in various biological processes.
 
 
 
• **Hydroxide (OH-)**
 
 
• The hydroxide ion (OH-) is a diatomic anion consisting of oxygen and hydrogen.
 
• It is commonly found in bases and is responsible for the basic (alkaline) nature of compounds.
 
• Hydroxide ions can neutralize acids, forming water and salts.
 
 
 
• **Magnesium Hydroxide (Mg(OH)2)**
 
 
• Magnesium hydroxide is a white solid with low solubility in water.
 
• It is used in medicine as an antacid to neutralize stomach acid and relieve indigestion and heartburn.
 
• It is also used as a laxative to alleviate constipation.
 
• In industrial applications, magnesium hydroxide is used as a fire retardant and in wastewater treatment.
